_comment: Paragraph style CSS for hyphenation (#208). Read by hyphenation.test.js (buildStyleCssBlock) and tests/Unit/ParagraphStylesHyphenationTest.php (generate_style_css), so both generators are held to the same text. css is the whole output for style id 9; an empty string means the style writes no CSS.

cases.label: a limit with JavaScript whitespace around it, which PHP's is_numeric() alone rejects
a limit with a NUL byte is not a number in either generator
off writes nothing, also with limits left over
an unknown hyphens value is off
all three limits and a character
one limit: the others are auto
limits as strings, above the cap, zero and negative
a fractional limit is floored
a non-ASCII character of several code points
a character with a quote is dropped
a character that is too long is dropped
after word spacing and line breaking, before the color
fit to width writes no hyphenation
the smallest limit, 1, is kept in both generators
